description.en-US: The space's segment of the path. Restricted to the characters S3 documents as safe in an object key, so a space maps one-to-one onto a key prefix. Unique among its siblings.
The enclosing space. Null for a root space, which is the tenant's own. Immutable: moving a space would invalidate the path of everything below it.
The materialised path from the root, the names joined by '/'. Written by the domain service only: on create from the parent's path, on rename for this space and every descendant in one transaction.
Total bytes of the files in this space and in every space below it. Maintained by the upload and delete paths, which add a file's size to the space and all its ancestors in one statement.
The id of the owning tenant, organization or user. Not a foreign key: iam sorts after itstorage in the migration order, so the constraint would point upwards.
Who manages the space. A 'system' space is created and removed by the platform, such as an organization's space during the org lifecycle.
The id or name of the manager when managed_by_type is not 'system'.
